           FABIANA IMBRICATA

         Pichi


A South American shrub cultivated in Southern California. It is a
        terebrinthine diuretic. It has also tonic and chologogue properties, used in the treatment
        of nasal catarrh, jaundice, dyspepsia and to increase the secretion of bile (Albert
        Schneider). Useful in the uric acid diathesis, cystitis, gonorrhœa,   prostatitis  ,
        dysuria, vesical catarrh with suppurative prostatic conditions; post-gonorrhœal urinary
        conditions; cholethiasis and liver affections. Vesical tenesmus and burning after urination.
        Excoriating urine and calculi.



Dose.--  Ten to twenty drops of the tincture.
